'''''Computational Statistics & Data Analysis''''' is a monthly [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] covering research on and applications of [[computational statistics]] and data analysis. The journal was established in 1983 and is the official journal of the [[International Association for Statistical Computing]],<ref>[http://www.iasc-isi.org/ About IASC]</ref>  a section of the [[International Statistical Institute]].
